motivation: In round 1 the correct declaration was present in the 40-candidate pool for only 16/48 questions. B surfaced all 16 within top 8.
target: Explicit code-only jump-to-definition interaction; human action/query identifies one symbol. C sends the extracted symbol to the existing bare-symbol Knowledge search endpoint. No new index, model call or larger candidate pool. No silent rewrite of general documentation searches.
controls: A natural sentence, old exact-only ranking. B same sentence, scoped definition priority (round 1). C same underlying API and B code, query canonicalized to symbol only for explicit definition navigation. All code-only documents, matched queries and labels.
cohort: 24 original dev reused; all 33 unused targets from round 1 form a new holdout with no reused gold_file or symbol. No substitutions.
metrics: Hit@1 primary, Hit@8 and MRR@8, A/B/C top-8 source and hash checks, 3 counterbalanced search times/arm/question and P95.
accept_if: C vs B adds >=5 percentage points of Hit@1 with nondecreasing aggregate Hit@8 and P95 ratio <=1.25; control queries must return identical rows, denied reader gets zero results. No claim about unconstrained natural-language QA.
